source_dataset.name: MaleCNS
source_dataset.official_neuron_count_source: MaleCNS v1.0 is described as approximately 166,700 neurons (project figure supplied at review); it equals the 166,700 bodies with a non-null 'superclass' in body-annotations v1.0 (empirical). The Cell paper reports 166,691 (search-only). Not the canonical graph count.
source_dataset.description: The source dataset as published. The canonical simulation graph is a selected subset of it; its counts must never be presented as the dataset's neuron census.

canonical_graph.description: Canonical simulation graph: neurons selected by selection_rule and the directed connections between them. NOT the complete neuron census of the source dataset.

provenance.biological_interpretation: NONE. This artifact is a structural subgraph of the canonical simulation graph selected purely by the extractor configuration. It carries no behavioral or functional claim.
